title: Position Generator
source_docs: Motor Control Blockset HDL Support/Controls/Control Reference/Position_Generator.md
text: Generate position ramp of fixed frequency, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Theta Units} sets Unit of θ; {Initial state} sets how to provide initial value of θ Specify via, {Initial theta value} sets the initial value of θ e and {External reset} sets the output value on reset. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Theta Units
params.values: Unit of θ Per-unit (default) | Radians | Degrees

params.name: Initial state
params.values: Specify how to provide initial value of θ Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Initial theta value
params.values: Initial value of θ e 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: External reset
params.values: Output value on reset none (default) | active high resets to zero | active high resets to initial condition
